### The Teardown: Through-Glass Vias in Glass Interposers
Take it apart and the bottleneck appears at the moment a femtosecond laser must drill a precise via through glass without cracking the surrounding material or leaving debris that blocks later copper plating. The laser fires pulses lasting only femtoseconds so heat does not propagate into the glass matrix, allowing the beam to ablate a clean cylindrical hole while the rest of the interposer stays intact.
